Our Four Games

Game 1: Card Matching

Card Matching is a classic puzzle game that tests participants' memory and observation skills. A deck of playing cards is placed face down on a table. Each team selects one representative. Players take turns flipping over two cards. If the cards match, the player collects the pair. If they do not match, both cards are turned face down again.

The game continues until a team collects four pairs. The team with the most pairs wins.

Ranking points: 1st – 10 points · 2nd – 7 points · 3rd – 5 points · 4th – 3 points

Game 2: Card-Blowing Game

This exciting party game tests participants' control and blowing technique. A deck of playing cards is placed on top of an empty bottle. Each team chooses one representative. Players take turns blowing cards off the bottle.

Players try to blow off at least one card without knocking the whole remaining stack off. A player who blows off the final card or knocks down the whole stack is out. The last player remaining wins.

Ranking points: 1st – 10 points · 2nd – 7 points · 3rd – 5 points · 4th – 3 points

Game 3: Cornhole (Bean Bag Toss)

Cornhole is a casual game that tests hand-eye coordination and throwing accuracy. Players throw bean bags towards an inclined board with a hole. Each team sends two players, who take turns throwing towards the opposite board.

A bean bag in the hole earns 3 points, while a bag landing on the board earns 1 point. Bags landing on the ground earn no points. The first team to reach exactly 21 points wins.

Ranking points: 1st – 10 points · 2nd – 7 points · 3rd – 5 points · 4th – 3 points

Game 4: The King Game

The King Game encourages teamwork and interaction. Prepare one small stick for each participant. Mark one stick in red as the King stick and put a number on each of the other sticks. Everyone randomly draws one stick.

The person who draws the King stick becomes the King and calls a number to choose a participant for a task. Each task has a point value. If the participant completes the task, their team earns those points; if not, the points are deducted. Collect and reshuffle the sticks for each new round. The team with the highest total score wins.

Ranking points: 1st – 10 points · 2nd – 7 points · 3rd – 5 points · 4th – 3 points
